health.title: Sources & disclaimer
health.categories: Categories follow the standard adult ranges published by the WHO and the CDC: below 18.5 underweight, 18.5 to 24.9 healthy weight, 25 to 29.9 overweight, 30 and above obesity.
health.disclaimer: BMI is a general screening estimate. It does not measure body fat or muscle mass and is not a diagnosis. The information in Athletx is for general fitness purposes only and is not medical advice. Talk to a doctor or other qualified healthcare professional before starting a new exercise or nutrition program, or if you have questions about your health.

cdcAdult.covers: Adult BMI ranges: underweight, healthy weight, overweight, obesity.

cdcChild.title: Child and Teen BMI Categories
cdcChild.publisher: U.S. Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC)
cdcChild.covers: Why BMI for people under 18 is read as an age- and sex-specific percentile.

health.minorBmi: For people under 18, BMI is interpreted as a percentile for age and sex, so adult categories don't apply. A doctor can tell you what your BMI means for you.
